title: 헬스장 등록: 몇 개월 해요? 뭐가 필요해요?
objective: Sign up at a gym (membership, clothes, lockers, PT) and describe nouns with V-는.
summary: A short gym front-desk conversation with key words and V-는 + noun.
setting: At the front desk of a neighborhood gym. A new customer wants to sign up, and a staff member explains the options.

task.title: Use the gym expressions
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to fill in, choose, put in order, or answer each question.

words.exampleMeaning: Did you put your workout clothes in your bag?

words.meaning: to borrow; to rent (use something and give it back)
words.exampleMeaning: Borrow a towel at the front desk.
Please change your clothes in the locker room.

words.meaning: to apply for; to ask for (a service)
words.exampleMeaning: I applied for swimming lessons online.

words.meaning: describes a noun with an action happening now or usually ("the N that ~"). Add -는 to the verb stem, after a vowel or a consonant: 빌리다 → 빌리는, 받다 → 받는. If the stem ends in ㄹ, drop the ㄹ: 만들다 → 만드는.
words.example: 요즘 다니는 헬스장이 집 앞에 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The gym I go to these days is right in front of my house.

dialogue.meaning: Hello. I'd like to sign up at the gym.

dialogue.korean: 1개월, 3개월, 6개월 회원권이 있어요. 길게 하시면 더 싸요.
dialogue.meaning: We have 1-month, 3-month, and 6-month memberships. A longer one is cheaper.

dialogue.korean: 그럼 3개월로 할게요. 운동복도 빌릴 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: Then I'll take 3 months. Can I rent workout clothes too?

dialogue.korean: 네, 운동복을 빌리는 분은 조금 더 내셔야 해요. 수건은 무료예요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, people who rent workout clothes pay a little more. Towels are free.

dialogue.korean: 저는 집에서 가져올게요. 사물함은 어디에 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: I'll bring my own from home. Where are the lockers?

dialogue.korean: 탈의실 안에 있어요. 매일 쓰는 사물함이 필요하면 따로 신청하세요.
dialogue.meaning: They're in the locker room. If you want your own locker to use every day, sign up for it separately.
That's okay, I don't need one. Also, I'd like to get personal training.

dialogue.korean: 저기 계시는 분이 트레이너예요. 이 신청서를 쓰시고 상담해 보세요.
dialogue.meaning: The person over there is a trainer. Fill out this form and then talk with the trainer.

exercises: Change the verb in brackets to the V-는 form: PT를 ____ 회원은 이 표를 보세요. (받다)
Choose the right word (사물함 / 탈의실 / 회원권): 가방은 ____에 넣고 열쇠를 가져가세요.
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 카운터로 / 오세요 / 수건을 빌리는 분은
Answer in Korean, using the dialogue: 손님은 몇 개월 회원권으로 했어요?
